layer_height.oque: How thick each printed layer is.
layer_height.efeito: Thinner layers give a smoother surface but take longer. Thicker layers print fast and show more stair-stepping.

initial_layer_print_height.oque: Thickness of the layer that touches the bed.
initial_layer_print_height.efeito: A bit thicker helps the part stick and forgives a slightly uneven bed.

line_width.oque: Width of each extruded plastic line.
line_width.efeito: Wider lines make the part stronger and faster; narrower lines show more detail.

wall_loops.oque: How many outline loops the part has.
wall_loops.efeito: More loops make a stronger part but use more time and filament.

top_shell_layers.oque: How many solid layers close off the top.
top_shell_layers.efeito: Too few leave holes or a wavy top; more layers close it better but use more filament.

bottom_shell_layers.oque: How many solid layers form the bottom of the part.
bottom_shell_layers.efeito: More layers give a sturdier, watertight bottom.

top_shell_thickness.oque: Minimum thickness of the solid top.
top_shell_thickness.efeito: If the top layers add up to less than this, the slicer adds more layers.

bottom_shell_thickness.oque: Minimum thickness of the solid bottom.
bottom_shell_thickness.efeito: Keeps the bottom solid even with thin layers.

sparse_infill_density.oque: How much of the part's inside is filled with plastic.
sparse_infill_density.efeito: 15% to 20% works for most parts. More infill makes the part stronger, heavier and slower to print.

sparse_infill_pattern.oque: The pattern printed inside the part.
sparse_infill_pattern.efeito: Gyroid and cubic are strong in every direction; grid and lines print faster.

seam_position.oque: Where each wall loop starts and ends.
seam_position.efeito: Aligned leaves a subtle line on one corner; random scatters the mark around the part.

enable_support.oque: Builds supports under areas that would otherwise print in mid-air.
enable_support.efeito: Needed for steep overhangs and long bridges. Uses filament and leaves marks where it touches.

support_type.efeito: Tree uses less filament and comes off easier; normal holds large flat surfaces better.

support_threshold_angle.oque: The overhang angle at which the part gets support.
support_threshold_angle.efeito: A lower angle creates less support; a higher one creates more. 30° to 45° is typical.

support_on_build_plate_only.oque: Only creates support that starts from the bed.
support_on_build_plate_only.efeito: Avoids support resting on the part itself, which marks the surface.

brim_type.oque: A thin band around the base, printed on the first layer.
brim_type.efeito: Helps parts with a small footprint stay down and not warp. You peel it off afterward.

brim_width.oque: How far the brim extends out from the part.
brim_width.efeito: Wider holds better but takes more work to remove.

skirt_loops.oque: Lines printed around the part without touching it.
skirt_loops.efeito: Primes the nozzle and shows whether the first layer looks good before the part starts.

raft_layers.oque: A throwaway base printed under the part.
raft_layers.efeito: Helps materials that warp a lot; uses filament and leaves a rougher bottom.

outer_wall_speed.oque: Speed of the visible outer wall.
outer_wall_speed.efeito: Slower improves the finish; faster shortens the print.

inner_wall_speed.efeito: Can be faster than the outer wall without hurting looks.

sparse_infill_speed.efeito: Can be high: the inside isn't visible.

initial_layer_speed.oque: Speed of the layer that touches the bed.
initial_layer_speed.efeito: Slow helps the part stick. This is the layer that fails most when printed too fast.

travel_speed.oque: How fast the nozzle moves when it isn't printing.
travel_speed.efeito: Faster cuts print time and stringing.

default_acceleration.oque: How quickly the printer changes speed.
default_acceleration.efeito: Higher shortens the print; too high causes ripples (ghosting) near corners.

nozzle_temperature.efeito: Too low causes under-extrusion and weak layers; too high oozes and strings. Follow the range on the filament label.

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.oque: Nozzle temperature for the layer that touches the bed only.
nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.efeito: A few degrees hotter helps adhesion.

hot_plate_temp.efeito: Keeps the base stuck down. PLA runs around 55–65 °C, PETG 70–80 °C, ABS/ASA 90–100 °C.

textured_plate_temp.oque: Bed temperature when using the textured (PEI) plate.
textured_plate_temp.efeito: Usually a few degrees higher than the smooth plate for the same material.

filament_flow_ratio.oque: Fine-tunes how much plastic is extruded.
filament_flow_ratio.efeito: Above 1 lays down more (fuller part, may smear); below 1 lays down less (may leave gaps).

filament_max_volumetric_speed.oque: How much plastic per second this filament can melt.
filament_max_volumetric_speed.efeito: This is the material's real speed limit. Go past it and extrusion fails.

fan_min_speed.oque: Lowest speed of the part cooling fan.
fan_min_speed.efeito: PLA likes lots of airflow; ABS and ASA want almost none, so they don't crack.

fan_max_speed.oque: Highest speed of the part cooling fan.
fan_max_speed.efeito: Used on fast layers, bridges and overhangs.

retraction_length.oque: How far the filament is pulled back before the nozzle travels.
retraction_length.efeito: Reduces stringing. Too much can clog; too little leaves strings between parts.

retraction_speed.oque: How fast the filament is pulled back.
retraction_speed.efeito: Fast cuts strings better; too fast grinds the filament.

z_hop.oque: The nozzle lifts slightly while traveling.
z_hop.efeito: Avoids hitting or scratching the part; can increase stringing.

ironing_type.oque: The nozzle passes over the top again to smooth it.
ironing_type.efeito: A much smoother top, with longer print time.

fuzzy_skin.oque: Gives the outer wall a rough texture.
fuzzy_skin.efeito: Hides layer lines and improves grip.

spiral_mode.oque: Prints the part as a single continuous spiral wall.
spiral_mode.efeito: For vases and hollow parts: no seam, no infill and no top.

prime_tower_width.oque: Size of the tower used for color changes.
prime_tower_width.efeito: A bigger tower purges the previous color better and uses more filament.

enable_prime_tower.oque: A tower where the nozzle dumps the previous color at each change.
enable_prime_tower.efeito: Keeps colors clean on multi-color parts.

flush_into_infill.oque: Uses the part's interior to purge the previous color.
flush_into_infill.efeito: Saves filament on color changes; the mixed color stays hidden inside.

wall_generator.oque: How walls are calculated: Classic or Arachne.
wall_generator.efeito: Arachne varies line width and fills thin areas better.

elefant_foot_compensation.efeito: Fixes a base that flares out from being squished against the bed.

xy_hole_compensation.oque: Makes the part's holes bigger or smaller.
xy_hole_compensation.efeito: Use it when holes come out too tight or too loose for a fit.

xy_contour_compensation.oque: Makes the outer contour bigger or smaller.
xy_contour_compensation.efeito: Use it when the part comes out larger or smaller than it should.

bridge_speed.oque: Speed when printing spans with nothing underneath.

overhang_fan_speed.oque: Fan speed on overhangs and bridges.
overhang_fan_speed.efeito: More airflow sets the plastic before it sags.

print_sequence.oque: Prints by layer (all parts together) or by object (one at a time).
print_sequence.efeito: By object avoids strings between parts but needs space between them.

curr_bed_type.oque: Which plate is on the printer.
curr_bed_type.efeito: Changes the bed temperature and first layer height used.

ferramenta:add.oque: Brings a 3D file (STL, 3MF, STEP, OBJ) onto the plate.
ferramenta:add.efeito: You can add several; each one becomes a part on the plate.

ferramenta:addplate.oque: Adds another plate to the same project.
ferramenta:addplate.efeito: Handy when the parts don't fit in one print; each plate is sliced and printed separately.

ferramenta:orient.oque: Rotates the part to the position that prints best.
ferramenta:orient.efeito: Usually reduces support and increases contact with the bed.

ferramenta:arrange.oque: Spreads the parts across the plate without touching each other.
ferramenta:arrange.efeito: Makes better use of space and keeps parts inside the printable area.

ferramenta:more.oque: Adds a copy of the selected part.
ferramenta:more.efeito: Use it to print several identical parts on the same plate.

ferramenta:fewer.oque: Removes a copy of the selected part.

ferramenta:splitobjects.oque: Splits a file with several loose pieces into separate objects.
ferramenta:splitobjects.efeito: Each piece can be moved, rotated and set up on its own.

ferramenta:splitvolumes.oque: Splits the object into parts that stay together.
ferramenta:splitvolumes.efeito: Lets you give each part its own color or settings without breaking up the assembly.

ferramenta:layersediting.oque: Changes the layer height along the part.
ferramenta:layersediting.efeito: Thin layers on curves and details, thick ones on straight sections: better finish without doubling the time.

ferramenta:assembly_view.oque: Shows the parts assembled, off the plate.
ferramenta:assembly_view.efeito: Good for checking fits; it doesn't change the print.

gizmo:toolbar_move.oque: Drags the part around the plate.
gizmo:toolbar_move.efeito: Position on the plate doesn't affect quality; avoid the edges if the bed heats less there.

gizmo:toolbar_rotate.oque: Rotates the part on any axis.
gizmo:toolbar_rotate.efeito: Orientation decides where support goes and which direction the part is strongest.

gizmo:toolbar_scale.oque: Makes the part bigger or smaller.
gizmo:toolbar_scale.efeito: With the lock closed it keeps proportions; open, it stretches just one side.

gizmo:toolbar_flatten.oque: Click a face and it becomes the base.
gizmo:toolbar_flatten.efeito: The fastest way to get the part sitting flat.

gizmo:toolbar_cut.oque: Splits the part with a plane.
gizmo:toolbar_cut.efeito: Lets you print in two halves (no support) or make parts bigger than the plate, with connectors.

gizmo:toolbar_meshboolean.efeito: Union joins them, difference cuts a hole shaped like the other, intersection keeps only what they share.

gizmo:toolbar_support.oque: Paint where you want support and where you don't.
gizmo:toolbar_support.efeito: Gives fine control: support only where needed, none where it would mark the part.

gizmo:toolbar_seam.oque: Paint where the layer seam should or shouldn't go.
gizmo:toolbar_seam.efeito: Hides the mark on a corner or the back.

gizmo:toolbar_fuzzy_skin_paint.oque: Paint the areas that get fuzzy skin.
gizmo:toolbar_fuzzy_skin_paint.efeito: Texture only where it matters, like the grip on a handle.

gizmo:mmu_segmentation.oque: Paint the part with your filament colors.
gizmo:mmu_segmentation.efeito: Each painted color becomes a filament change during the print.

gizmo:toolbar_text.oque: Adds raised or engraved text to the part.
gizmo:toolbar_text.efeito: Great for names, logos or serial numbers.

gizmo:toolbar_measure.oque: Measures distance, angle and diameter on the part.

gizmo:toolbar_assembly.oque: Snaps one part onto another by faces or points.
gizmo:toolbar_assembly.efeito: Helps position the pieces of an assembly.

gizmo:toolbar_brimears.oque: Adds small discs at corners that tend to lift.
gizmo:toolbar_brimears.efeito: Holds just the corners, with less waste than a full brim.

gizmo:reduce_triangles.efeito: Makes heavy files lighter; overdo it and you lose detail.

gizmo:toolbar_texture_displacement.oque: Applies an image texture to the surface.

initial_layer_line_width.oque: Line width on the layer that touches the bed.
initial_layer_line_width.efeito: A bit wider sticks better and covers small leveling flaws.

outer_wall_line_width.oque: Line width of the visible wall.
outer_wall_line_width.efeito: Thinner shows more detail; wider makes the wall stronger and faster.

inner_wall_line_width.oque: Line width of the hidden walls.
inner_wall_line_width.efeito: Wider makes the part stronger and prints faster.

top_surface_line_width.oque: Line width of the final top layer.
top_surface_line_width.efeito: Thinner gives a smoother, better-closed top.

sparse_infill_line_width.oque: Line width used inside the part.
sparse_infill_line_width.efeito: Wider fills faster and makes the core stronger.

internal_solid_infill_line_width.oque: Line width of the inner solid layers.
internal_solid_infill_line_width.efeito: Wider prints faster; thinner closes better.

support_line_width.efeito: Thinner comes off easier; wider holds more firmly.

bridge_line_width.oque: Width of the line stretched across mid-air.
bridge_line_width.efeito: Thinner cools faster and sags less.

staggered_inner_seams.oque: Spreads out where each inner wall starts and ends.
staggered_inner_seams.efeito: Keeps the seams from stacking on top of each other and weakening the part.

seam_gap.oque: How far short of the loop's start the loop ends.
seam_gap.efeito: A small gap prevents a "zit" at the seam.

seam_slope_type.oque: Starts and ends each wall loop on a gradual ramp.
seam_slope_type.efeito: The seam nearly disappears; takes a little longer.

wipe_on_loops.oque: After finishing a wall, the nozzle moves a bit inward before lifting.
wipe_on_loops.efeito: Hides the seam point and reduces blobs.

wipe_speed.oque: Speed of the nozzle wipe at the end of a line.
wipe_speed.efeito: Too fast doesn't wipe; too slow melts the wall.

resolution.oque: Simplifies details smaller than this value when slicing.
resolution.efeito: A higher value slices faster and makes a smaller file, with less detail.

enable_arc_fitting.oque: Replaces many straight segments with arcs (G2/G3) in the G-code.
enable_arc_fitting.efeito: Smaller file and smoother curves, if your printer supports arcs.

precise_outer_wall.oque: Adjusts wall spacing so outer dimensions come out exact.
precise_outer_wall.efeito: Helps parts that need to fit together come out to size.

precise_z_height.oque: Adjusts the last layers so the part comes out at the right height.
precise_z_height.efeito: Good for parts where height really matters.

ironing_pattern.oque: Pattern of the ironing passes on the top.
ironing_pattern.efeito: Concentric suits round parts; lines suit straight ones.

ironing_flow.oque: How much plastic comes out during the ironing pass.
ironing_flow.efeito: Too little leaves streaks; too much leaves bumps.

ironing_spacing.efeito: Smaller is smoother and takes longer.

wall_sequence.oque: Whether the inner or outer wall prints first.
wall_sequence.efeito: Inner → outer gives a nicer outer wall; outer → inner gives more accurate dimensions.

is_infill_first.oque: Prints the core before the walls on each layer.
is_infill_first.efeito: Firmer walls, but the infill may show through on the outside.

print_flow_ratio.oque: Multiplies all the plastic extruded in this process.
print_flow_ratio.efeito: Use it to fix under-extrusion (raise it) or over-extrusion (lower it).

only_one_wall_top.titulo: Only one wall on top surfaces
only_one_wall_top.oque: Uses a single wall on the top layer.
only_one_wall_top.efeito: Cleaner top and more room for top infill.

only_one_wall_first_layer.titulo: Only one wall on first layer
only_one_wall_first_layer.oque: Uses a single wall on the bed layer.

reduce_crossing_wall.oque: The nozzle detours so it doesn't travel over walls.
reduce_crossing_wall.efeito: Fewer strings and marks on the outside; slightly longer travel moves.

bridge_flow.oque: How much plastic comes out on mid-air sections.
bridge_flow.efeito: A little less keeps the bridge taut and keeps it from sagging.

thick_bridges.oque: Uses the full nozzle width on bridges.
thick_bridges.efeito: Stronger, more reliable bridges; slightly heavier.

enable_extra_bridge_layer.oque: Prints a second bridge layer on top of the first.
enable_extra_bridge_layer.efeito: Closes the top of large spans better.

detect_overhang_wall.oque: Finds walls that stick out past the layer below.
detect_overhang_wall.efeito: Lets those areas print slower and with more cooling.

make_overhang_printable.oque: Reshapes the area under overhangs so they're self-supporting.
make_overhang_printable.efeito: Prints overhangs without support; changes the shape slightly.

extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.oque: Adds walls where the part hangs in mid-air.
extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.efeito: Better overhangs, using a bit more filament.

overhang_reverse.oque: Alternates wall direction on layers with overhangs.
overhang_reverse.efeito: Reduces edges curling up in mid-air.

hole_to_polyhole.efeito: Holes come out to size, great for screws and shafts.

zaa_enabled.oque: Adjusts nozzle height within the layer on sloped surfaces.
zaa_enabled.efeito: Sloped tops come out smoother, with less stair-stepping.

wall_distribution_count.oque: How many walls can change width in thin areas (Arachne).
wall_distribution_count.efeito: More walls spread the difference out better.

min_bead_width.oque: The thinnest line the slicer will still use.
min_bead_width.efeito: Smaller prints finer details; too small can fail.

min_feature_size.oque: Details smaller than this are ignored.

top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.oque: Plastic on the final top layer.
top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.efeito: Fine-tune it for a closed, smooth top.

bottom_solid_infill_flow_ratio.oque: Plastic on the bottom solid layers.
bottom_solid_infill_flow_ratio.efeito: Fine-tune it for a solid bottom.

first_layer_flow_ratio.efeito: A little more helps adhesion; too much causes "elephant foot".

detect_thin_wall.oque: Prints walls too thin for two lines with a single line.
detect_thin_wall.efeito: Fine details show up instead of disappearing.

alternate_extra_wall.oque: Adds an extra wall on every other layer.
alternate_extra_wall.efeito: Stronger walls without the cost of a full extra wall.

top_surface_pattern.oque: Line pattern of the final top layer.
top_surface_pattern.efeito: Monotonic gives a more even top; concentric suits round parts.

bottom_surface_pattern.oque: Line pattern of the bottom layer.
bottom_surface_pattern.efeito: Changes how the part's base looks.

top_surface_density.oque: How closed the final top layer is.
top_surface_density.efeito: 100% closes it fully; less gives a decorative effect.

internal_solid_infill_pattern.oque: Pattern of the inner solid layers.
internal_solid_infill_pattern.efeito: Rectilinear is the fastest and sturdiest.

gyroid_optimized.oque: A lighter version of gyroid infill.
gyroid_optimized.efeito: Slices faster with almost the same strength.

infill_direction.efeito: Rotate it to line up strength with the load the part will take.

infill_anchor.oque: A short line segment that connects infill to the wall.
infill_anchor.efeito: Ties the core to the walls better.

infill_anchor_max.titulo: Maximum length of the infill anchor
infill_anchor_max.oque: Maximum length of the segment that connects infill to the wall.
infill_anchor_max.efeito: Longer bonds more; too long leaves marks.

filter_out_gap_fill.oque: Skips filling gaps smaller than this value.
filter_out_gap_fill.efeito: Fewer short moves and faster printing.

infill_wall_overlap.oque: How far the infill reaches into the wall.
infill_wall_overlap.efeito: More overlap bonds better; too much shows on the outside.

ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.oque: Adds solid fill where walls would get thin on sloped surfaces.

minimum_sparse_infill_area.oque: Areas smaller than this become solid.

infill_combination.oque: Prints infill every other layer, twice as thick.
infill_combination.efeito: Prints faster without changing the walls.

top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap.oque: How far the top and bottom reach into the wall.
top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap.efeito: More overlap prevents gaps at the edge.

extra_solid_infills.oque: Adds extra solid layers at heights you choose.
extra_solid_infills.efeito: Reinforces the part where it takes the most stress.

initial_layer_infill_speed.oque: Speed of the core on the bed layer.

initial_layer_travel_speed.oque: Travel speed (not printing) on the first layer.
initial_layer_travel_speed.efeito: Slower avoids knocking loose what was just printed.

slow_down_layers.oque: How many layers ramp up gradually after the first.
slow_down_layers.efeito: More layers give the base time to settle.

small_perimeter_speed.oque: Speed for holes and small outlines.
small_perimeter_speed.efeito: Slower gives round holes and clean details.

internal_solid_infill_speed.oque: Speed of the inner solid layers.
internal_solid_infill_speed.efeito: Can be fast: it isn't visible.

top_surface_speed.oque: Speed of the final top layer.

gap_infill_speed.oque: Speed for filling gaps between walls.

ironing_speed.oque: Speed of the pass that smooths the top.

support_speed.efeito: Can be fast: the support comes off later.

support_interface_speed.oque: Speed of the layer that touches the part.
support_interface_speed.efeito: Slower gives a nicer underside on the part.

outer_wall_acceleration.oque: How quickly the visible wall gets up to speed.
outer_wall_acceleration.efeito: Lower gives a nicer wall, without "ghosting".

travel_acceleration.oque: How quickly it accelerates on non-printing moves.
travel_acceleration.efeito: Higher saves time; too high makes the printer shake.

default_jerk.efeito: Lower gives smoother corners; higher prints faster.

max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope.oque: Limits how quickly plastic flow can change.

support_style.oque: Support shape: grid, slim tree, organic tree…
support_style.efeito: Organic uses less and comes off easily; grid is sturdier.

support_top_z_distance.oque: Gap between the support and the part resting on it.
support_top_z_distance.efeito: Larger removes easier; smaller gives a smoother underside.

support_bottom_z_distance.oque: Gap between the part and support that starts on top of it.

support_interface_top_layers.oque: Denser layers where the support touches the part.
support_interface_top_layers.efeito: More layers give a smoother underside on the part.

support_interface_bottom_layers.oque: Dense layers where support starts on top of the part.

support_interface_pattern.oque: Line pattern that touches the part.
support_interface_pattern.efeito: Concentric or rectilinear change the finish and how easily it comes off.

support_interface_spacing.efeito: Smaller gives a smoother part; larger releases more easily.

support_base_pattern.efeito: Rectilinear is light; honeycomb is sturdier.

support_base_pattern_spacing.oque: Distance between the support core lines.
support_base_pattern_spacing.efeito: Larger uses less and removes easier.

support_object_xy_distance.oque: Side gap between the support and the part.
support_object_xy_distance.efeito: Larger keeps it from sticking to the part's sides.

support_remove_small_overhang.oque: Skips support for very small overhangs.

bridge_no_support.efeito: Saves support when the bridge is short.

max_bridge_length.efeito: Beyond that, it gets support in the middle.

tree_support_branch_angle.oque: Maximum tilt of tree support branches.
tree_support_branch_angle.efeito: Higher reaches farther; lower is sturdier.

tree_support_tip_diameter.oque: Diameter of the tip that touches the part.

tree_support_wall_count.oque: How many walls each branch has.
tree_support_wall_count.efeito: More walls make the branch sturdier.

raft_contact_distance.oque: Gap between the raft and the part's first layer.
raft_contact_distance.efeito: Larger releases easier; smaller gives a smoother base.

raft_expansion.oque: How far the raft extends past the part's edge.
raft_expansion.efeito: Larger holds better on the bed.

support_filament.efeito: Using a different material (soluble or interface) makes removal easier.

support_interface_filament.oque: Which filament prints the layer that touches the part.
support_interface_filament.efeito: An interface material lets the support come off clean.

support_ironing.oque: Runs the nozzle over the top of the support again.
support_ironing.efeito: The part's underside comes out smoother.

support_critical_regions_only.oque: Only adds support where the part would fail without it.

prime_volume.oque: Plastic purged in the tower on each color change.
prime_volume.efeito: More volume cleans the previous color better; uses more filament.

prime_tower_brim_width.efeito: Keeps the tower stuck to the bed so it doesn't topple.

ooze_prevention.oque: Lowers the temperature of the idle nozzle on multi-nozzle printers.
ooze_prevention.efeito: Fewer blobs and strings between colors.

flush_into_objects.oque: Color-change purge goes inside another part.
flush_into_objects.efeito: Saves filament by using the part as a waste bin.

flush_into_support.oque: Color-change purge goes into the support.
flush_into_support.efeito: Saves filament; the support comes out multicolored.

interlocking_beam.oque: Creates interlocking joints between parts in different materials.
interlocking_beam.efeito: Parts stay locked together instead of separating.

purge_in_prime_tower.oque: Does the color-change purge in the tower.
purge_in_prime_tower.efeito: Keeps leftovers of the previous color off the part.

wipe_tower_type.oque: Which prime tower style is used for color changes.
wipe_tower_type.efeito: Each type changes the tower's size and filament use.

skirt_type.oque: One skirt per part or one around everything.
skirt_type.efeito: A single skirt for everything saves time.

skirt_distance.oque: Gap between the skirt and the part.
skirt_distance.efeito: Too close can fuse to the part.

skirt_height.oque: How many layers the skirt has.
skirt_height.efeito: More layers shield against drafts (draft shield).

draft_shield.oque: Turns the skirt into a wall around the part, as tall as the part.
draft_shield.efeito: Protects ABS and ASA from drafts and cracking.

brim_object_gap.oque: Small gap between the brim and the part's wall.
brim_object_gap.efeito: Makes the brim easier to remove without marks.

slicing_mode.oque: How the slicer handles models with holes or open meshes.
slicing_mode.efeito: Regular is the default; the others help with broken models.

print_order.oque: Order in which the parts on the plate are printed.

fuzzy_skin_mode.oque: Choose whether the texture goes on the outside only or on holes too.
fuzzy_skin_mode.efeito: Use outside only to keep fitting surfaces smooth.

fuzzy_skin_thickness.oque: How far the rough texture moves in and out of the wall.

timelapse_type.oque: How the camera records the print video.
timelapse_type.efeito: Smooth moves the part out of the way for each shot.

exclude_object.oque: Tags each part in the G-code so you can cancel just one.
exclude_object.efeito: If one fails, the others keep printing.

gcode_label_objects.oque: Writes each part's name into the file.
gcode_label_objects.efeito: Required to cancel parts on the printer.

reduce_infill_retraction.oque: Skips retraction on travel moves inside the infill.
reduce_infill_retraction.efeito: Prints faster; any strings stay hidden.

filament_type.efeito: Sets the material's temperatures and rules.

filament_diameter.efeito: Getting it wrong causes under- or over-extrusion.

filament_density.oque: Weight per volume of the material.
filament_density.efeito: Used to calculate how many grams the part uses.

filament_cost.oque: Cost per kilogram of the spool.
filament_cost.efeito: Used for the part's cost and sale price.

filament_shrink.oque: How much the material shrinks as it cools.
filament_shrink.efeito: The slicer scales the part up to compensate.

filament_soluble.oque: Material that dissolves in water or a solvent.
filament_soluble.efeito: Great for support that disappears on its own.

filament_is_support.efeito: Used as interface so the support comes off clean.

enable_pressure_advance.oque: Compensates for pressure inside the nozzle when speed changes.

pressure_advance.oque: How much the printer compensates for pressure.
pressure_advance.efeito: Calibrate per material: accurate corners with no gaps.

temperature_vitrification.oque: Temperature at which the material starts to soften.
temperature_vitrification.efeito: Helps decide cooling and bed settings.

idle_temperature.oque: Temperature of the idle nozzle on multi-nozzle printers.

filament_colour.oque: The color shown in the app.
filament_colour.efeito: Helps you check colors before printing.

close_fan_the_first_x_layers.oque: How many initial layers print with the fan off.
close_fan_the_first_x_layers.efeito: The base stays warm and sticks better.

initial_layer_fan_speed.oque: Fan power on the bed layer.

full_fan_speed_layer.oque: Layer at which the fan reaches full power.
full_fan_speed_layer.efeito: Ramps up gradually so the base doesn't lift.

slow_down_for_layer_cooling.titulo: Slow printing down for better layer cooling
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.oque: Prints layers that would finish too quickly more slowly.
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.efeito: Gives them time to cool so tips don't melt.

dont_slow_down_outer_wall.oque: The outer wall keeps its speed when slowing down for cooling.

slow_down_min_speed.oque: The slowest the printer goes while waiting for a layer to cool.
slow_down_min_speed.efeito: Keeps it from lingering and melting the part.

enable_overhang_bridge_fan.titulo: Force cooling for overhangs and bridges
enable_overhang_bridge_fan.oque: Boosts the fan on overhangs and bridges.

overhang_fan_threshold.oque: How far an overhang must stick out to get extra fan.

internal_bridge_fan_speed.oque: Fan power on bridges inside the part.

additional_cooling_fan_speed.oque: Power of the chamber's side fan.
additional_cooling_fan_speed.efeito: Helps with PLA; turn it off for ABS and ASA.

ironing_fan_speed.oque: Fan power while ironing the top.
ironing_fan_speed.efeito: Less fan gives a smoother top.

reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.oque: Keeps the fan running between layers.
reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.efeito: Less wear and more even cooling.

printable_height.oque: The tallest part the printer can make.
printable_height.efeito: The slicer warns you when you go over it.

z_offset.oque: Raises or lowers the nozzle on every layer.
z_offset.efeito: Fixes a first layer that's too squished or too loose.

gcode_flavor.oque: The G-code dialect your printer understands.
gcode_flavor.efeito: The wrong one makes the printer ignore commands.

use_relative_e_distances.oque: Counts the plastic for each move separately.
use_relative_e_distances.efeito: The default on most current printers.

use_firmware_retraction.efeito: You tune retraction directly on the printer.

auxiliary_fan.oque: Tells the slicer whether the printer has a side fan.
auxiliary_fan.efeito: Enables the commands for that fan.

extruder_clearance_radius.efeito: Used to print one part at a time without collisions.

extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.oque: Height between the nozzle and the X-axis rod.
extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.efeito: Limits how tall parts can be when printed one at a time.

time_cost.oque: What one hour of printer run time costs.

nozzle_diameter.oque: Size of the nozzle opening: 0.4 mm is standard.
nozzle_diameter.efeito: A bigger nozzle prints fast; a smaller one does detail.

nozzle_type.efeito: Fiber-filled materials need a hardened nozzle.

min_layer_height.oque: The thinnest layer this nozzle can do.

max_layer_height.oque: The thickest layer this nozzle can do.
max_layer_height.efeito: Usually up to 75% of the nozzle size.

retract_length_toolchange.oque: How far the filament pulls back when switching nozzles or colors.

extruder_offset.oque: This nozzle's offset relative to the first one.

emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.oque: Writes the max speeds and accelerations into the G-code.
emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.efeito: The printer follows the profile's limits.
